text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stop by to watch one of Mejiro Palmer's
dance
lessons.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wahey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wahey! Woo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Heyo! How's it going?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We're not playing hooky or anything,
'kay? We
just needed to shake things
up.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer was feeling down in the dumps,
so I
decided to cheer her up the Helios
way! Can I get
a "Wahey-hey"?! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's no biggie. I just can't get the

choreography down right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The song we're working on is, like, super hard, and I keep messing up the steps.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure I'm perf once it's go time
on stage,
so no worries!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I should probably get back to it, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What? Are you telling me to just let
loose?
choice_data_list: 深刻に考えず、さっきくらい楽しく踊ろう
一緒に振り付けの意味を考えよう

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That's a good point! Dancing is about feeling, and what's better than feelin' great?!
choice_data_list: すごく自由でよかった

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh. I guess I got so hung up on being
perfect
that it started messin' with my
vibes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, then! Who cares about messing
up,
anyway?! I'm gonna dance 'cause I
like it!
Waheeey!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Those moves are straight fire, girl!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I get the feeling I'm dancing way
better
than I did before we took a
break!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro Palmer is reminded of the
pure fun
that comes with dancing and
overcomes her
negative mindset.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah. All the moves have a meaning,
don't
they?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Maybe if I can get a better feel of what
the song's
about before trying to
memorize the moves,
things'll be easier...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Are you thinking what I'm thinking?
'Cause I'm
thinking it's time for some
karaoke!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, yeah! The best way to mull over
song lyrics
is while you're singing them
with your whole chest!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wahey! That's what I'm talkin' 'bout!
C'mon,
what're we still doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wahey! You come with us too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Mejiro Palmer deepens her

understanding of the song and masters
the dance
in no time.
